about_the_game:
A Cover-Up Simulator where choices kind of matter… a lot.

You are Agent, and it’s your job to decide how to deal with the evidence and witnesses of an undesirable event. Do it well and on time, or you’re fired. All from the safety of your desk.

You'll receive an initial dossier with basic information about the event and objectives. The rest is up to you.

It’s all about information.

Gather clues and intel in the form of KEYWORDS to add to your notebook, your inventory of knowledge.

Use KEYWORDS to:

  • Fill Action Plan forms deciding who or what to act upon, then await your Field Agents’ results.

  • Search databases for further intel.

  • Wiretap phone lines and spy on anyone involved.

Manage your resources!
You have 4 Agents in the field, every order you give them takes time to complete or attempt so prioritize, multitask, and plan ahead!

Time matters
It waits for no one. The longer you hesitate, the worse things get.

Choices matter

Every action gets it's own consequence. Beware of permanent results.

Stay ahead!
Follow the news, and make sure the story never gets out.

Get the full picture
Pin every piece of intel to your Crazy Board to see how everything connects and unlock IDEAS for specially specific orders.

Features

  • 100+ findable keywords to use!

  • Order how to deal with witnesses and evidence!

  • Choose between efficient or morally correct! And see what happens!

  • Gain intel and ideate new ways to influence the outside world!

  • Pneumatic Tubes!

  • Manually fast-forward time to skip waiting for results!

  • Don’t get fired (or go back in time and try again)!

  • Every attempt gets you closer to the full picture!

content_descriptors.notes: The game deals with concealing information from people, and contains the non-graphical option of getting rid of witnesses from different ages.
